title: Jade's Survival Hats
description: This project adds multiple custom hats in the game that are all able to be crafted and/or obtained in survival.
body:
Jade's Survival Hats is a custom datapack made by some random lady who likes Blockbench.

![An image of all the original hats!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e9ad31f9d2232d9fb59ab3ca66c4d77b135fe617.png)

**BE SURE TO ADD IT BOTH IN YOUR DATAPACK FOLDER AND RESOURCEPACKS FOLDER!**

The initial pack has 12 heats in total with 8 of them being dyeable!![Some of the dyeable hats.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b7ef1d58438f56ee5ae969c9351c907fc63b53d9.png)

All the hats are made in Blockbench by JaidenTheBun.

All of the hats are CRAFTABLE in survival mode so this pack can be added seemlessly to your worlds! To unlock the recipes just grab a leather helmet.


If the pack gets enough support I will make updates adding new hats and hat variations!

Feel free to join my discord! <3
